pokedexEntries.bk: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

pokedexEntries.wh: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Thought to be an embodiment of the sun, it appeared during a bitterly cold winter and saved Pokémon from freezing.

pokedexEntries.x: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

pokedexEntries.or: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.

pokedexEntries.y: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

pokedexEntries.as: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it is said that Volcarona’s fire provided a replacement for the sun.

pokedexEntries.us: As it flies, it scatters its flaming scales. It was feared by ancient people, who referred to it as “the rage of the sun.”

pokedexEntries.um: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.

pokedexEntries.sw: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it’s trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.

pokedexEntries.sh: This Pokémon emerges from a cocoon formed of raging flames. Ancient murals depict Volcarona as a deity of fire.
